basic_info.description: Two bedrooms and two bathrooms Northwest facing corner condo with breathtaking views that span from west of Twin Peaks to the Marin Headland, Golden Gate bridge, Alcatraz and the San Francisco Bay. Located at the peak of Russian Hill in the Summit, a luxury mid-century building designed by visionary modernist architect, Joseph Eichler. The property comprises an open layout kitchen/dining/living area surrounded by glass-to-ceiling glass walls and opening to a large terrace that runs the length of the unit and it can also be accessed by the two spacious bedrooms. Amenities include a 24-hour attended property, a lobby designed by the prestigious interior design firm ODADA, parking, storage, on-site management, an outdoor courtyard and a dog walk on the mezzanine level. Enjoy the proximity to world-class dining, shopping and cultural landmarks.
